lot: NEW-03 audit — Queue topology + retry SLO. Independent second-opinion review of the orchestrator's NEW-03 implementation BEFORE the Claude Code terminal audit. Output is a JSON verdict, NO code patches.
auditor_persona: Senior staff backend engineer specialized in Laravel queue topology, retry/backoff policy under SLO, observability for terminal failures, and operational hardening (Supervisor/Forge). Adversarial mindset: hunt for routing leaks (jobs landing on the wrong queue), backoff math errors, log payload regressions, optional-Sentry integration breaking environments without the SDK, and worker-config drift between docs and code.

modified_files: app/Jobs/DispatchDomainEventsJob.php — $backoff changed from [1,5,30,300] to [1,5,15,60,300] (5 entries to match $tries=5). failed() refactored: Log level upgraded warning→error (terminal failure deserves pager-grade), structured payload now includes domain_event_id/event_type/queue/connection/attempts/delay_since_creation_seconds/error/error_class, optional Sentry breadcrumb (category=queue.dispatch_domain_events.failed) guarded by class_exists(\Sentry\State\Scope::class) AND function_exists('Sentry\\addBreadcrumb') AND class_exists(\Sentry\Breadcrumb::class) so environments without the SDK are unaffected. handle() body NOT touched (NEW-01 frozen).

app/Jobs/SendFcmNotificationJob.php — constructor now calls $this->onQueue('notifications') so dispatch sites do NOT need to chain ->onQueue(...). tries=3 / backoff()=[10,30] / timeout=30 unchanged. handle() body NOT touched.
created_files: docs/operations/QUEUE_TOPOLOGY.md — SSOT for the 3-queue topology (high / notifications / default), Supervisor program blocks per lane (NOT a combined --queue list, to prevent FCM stalls from starving high), worker order rationale, retry policy table, monitoring snippets (queue:monitor, queue:failed, SQL pending count), troubleshooting (queue:retry, outbox:retry-failed, outbox:rescue, queue:restart, queue:flush), deployment checklist. References docs/QUEUE_WORKER_SETUP.md as the existing primer.

tests/Feature/Queue/QueueRoutingTest.php — 7 tests: dispatch_domain_events_job_targets_high_queue (Queue::fake + assertPushedOn), send_fcm_notification_job_targets_notifications_queue, send_fcm_via_topic_also_targets_notifications_queue, dispatch_domain_events_default_queue_property (instance inspection: $job->queue === 'high'), send_fcm_default_queue_property (instance inspection: $job->queue === 'notifications'), dispatch_domain_events_backoff_curve_is_5_steps_outlasting_pusher_restart (assertSame [1,5,15,60,300] + count===tries), send_fcm_backoff_is_short_to_avoid_amplifying_throttling (tries===3, backoff()===[10,30]).

audit_axes: G1 — Queue routing source-of-truth: confirm SendFcmNotificationJob constructor onQueue('notifications') is the SSOT and that we have NOT regressed by also setting a $queue property elsewhere that could conflict. Same for DispatchDomainEventsJob with 'high'.

G2 — Backoff curve match-up: validate $backoff has exactly 5 entries equal to [1,5,15,60,300] AND that count === $tries. Laravel re-uses the last value if the array is shorter than $tries; flag if a future bump of $tries would go beyond the array.

G3 — failed() observability regression risk: confirm the new structured log preserves AT LEAST the prior fields (domain_event_id, event_type, error). Verify the prefix `contract_violation: ` for PayloadMismatchException is still written to last_error AND survives in the Log::error context (not stripped or doubled).

G4 — Optional Sentry SDK: assess the triple guard (class_exists Scope + function_exists addBreadcrumb + class_exists Breadcrumb). Is it sufficient to ensure the code is a no-op when sentry/sentry-laravel is NOT installed? Flag any path that could fatal in dev.

G5 — Edge case: domainEvent is null in failed() (event row deleted before final attempt). Verify the code does NOT crash and the structured log still carries `domain_event_id` (raw int from $this->domainEventId).

G6 — `delay_since_creation_seconds` math: now()->diffInSeconds($createdAt) returns a positive number even if $createdAt is in the future (Carbon abs) — confirm casted to int is acceptable and not silently zero.

G7 — Default queue property: SendFcmNotificationJob does NOT declare `public string $queue` at class level; the value is only set via the runtime `onQueue()` call inside the constructor. Confirm `$job->queue === 'notifications'` is reliable for assertion (this is the contract assumed by the test).

G8 — Listener call sites: existing dispatchers (PersistOrderCreatedToOutbox etc.) STILL chain ->onQueue('high'). Confirm this is harmless (defense-in-depth) and does not double-set or override the constructor.

G9 — Topology doc consistency: the doc recommends 3 dedicated Supervisor programs (one per lane). The Lot README also mentions a fallback `--queue=high,notifications,default` for mono-worker dev. Confirm the doc is internally consistent and aligned with the Job class queue assignments.

G10 — Worker `--tries=0`: the doc recommends `--tries=0` so the per-job `$tries` is authoritative. Verify this matches Laravel 10 semantics (yes — `--tries=0` means rely on job class). Flag if the doc accidentally suggests a hard `--tries=N` that would override the job.
missing_test_axes_to_check: T-MISS-A — failed() with null DomainEvent: simulate a row deleted between the last attempt and the failed() callback; assert no crash, assert Log::error still carries domain_event_id from the job state, assert no DB::forceFill call.
T-MISS-B — failed() with PayloadMismatchException keeps the contract_violation: prefix in last_error AFTER the new structured log path runs.
T-MISS-C — failed() Sentry path is no-op when SDK absent: with Sentry classes intentionally NOT installed in test env, ensure the conditional block silently skips and no warning/notice is emitted.

T-MISS-D — explicit override of queue at dispatch time: SendFcmNotificationJob::dispatch(...)->onQueue('default') should still work (Laravel allows runtime override). Assert the override wins. Document if intentional.
T-MISS-E — backoff curve length: assert count(\$job->backoff) === \$job->tries (already covered partially in QueueRoutingTest, confirm).
